decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using spells like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back into play for a big impact. Using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to set up your draws and Thoughtseize to disrupt your opponent's strategy, you aim to create a powerful board presence with creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent. With control elements like Force of Will and Daze, along with disruptive creatures like Brazen Borrower, you aim to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and efficient reanimation combo strategy.

The primary focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt opponents' strategies through targeted removal, countermagic, and hand disruption while also generating card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Dack Fayden. The deck aims to control the game by efficiently answering threats and outvaluing opponents with powerful card draw and recursion spells like Reanimate. It also utilizes creatures like Baleful Strix and Hullbreacher to apply pressure and control the board. Overall, the deck seeks to dictate the pace of the game and overpower opponents with its versatile control elements.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around utilizing various creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure through aggressive plays. By combining disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Swords to Plowshares with efficient threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to control the board and win through incremental advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of the Companion mechanic with Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for extra value and flexibility in certain match-ups. Overall, the deck focuses on a proactive gameplay style that seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck focuses on using Nadu, Winged Wisdom along with Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfling to create an infinite combo of drawing cards and gaining life. The deck includes protection spells like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Will to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. Green Sun's Zenith helps tutor key pieces of the combo, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder provide card selection and deck manipulation. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck, with utility lands like Karakas and Dryad Arbor included for additional flexibility.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and ramp up mana quickly using cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Gaea's Cradle. The deck also uses efficient creatures like Noble Hierarch and Wight of the Reliquary to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Collector Ouphe. The inclusion of cards like Natural Order and Elvish Reclaimer allows for powerful creature-based combos to be utilized. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through resource management and strategic plays.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Daze and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly deploying threats like Kaito, Nethergoyf, and Brazen Borrower to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes a suite of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to maintain control of the board. By combining tempo-based disruption with efficient threats, this deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck is focused on quickly milling through your deck and getting all your combo pieces into your graveyard to win the game in one explosive turn. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill yourself, along with cards like Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle, you aim to win the game before your opponent has a chance to react. The deck also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect your combo. Overall, the strategy is to assemble your combo pieces quickly and efficiently to achieve a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling your entire deck with cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, using cards like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to generate mana, and then win the game either by casting Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return. The deck aims to be fast and consistent in executing its combo, utilizing spells like Dark Ritual and Cabal Ritual to power out its key pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation.

The focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It also utilizes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces. The deck includes cards that help filter through the library such as Brainstorm and Ponder. By using these tools, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with strong threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also being able to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Grindstone and Painter's Servant combo to mill out your opponent's deck. The deck includes cards that support this combo such as Goblin Engineer and Ancient Tomb. Additionally, there are key cards like Pyroblast for disruption and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for card advantage. Cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Goblin Welder provide additional synergy with the combo pieces. Overall, the deck focuses on executing the combo efficiently while controlling the game with disruptive spells and utility cards.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a combo using Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Plagon, Lord of the Beach, and Nadu, Winged Wisdom. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Chalice of the Void to accelerate mana and disrupt the opponent, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent quickly with a game-winning combo. With control elements like Force of Will and Cavern of Souls to protect the combo pieces, this deck is designed to be a fast and efficient threat in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like City of Traitors and Chrome Mox to cast powerful dragons and spells such as Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf. The deck also focuses on disrupting opponents' mana bases with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also controlling the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and finish them off with powerful dragons and burn spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly combo off and win the game with minimal interaction from the opponent. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the entire library, players can trigger the win condition with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to bring back key creatures. The deck also includes various fast mana sources like Lotus Petal and Dark Ritual, as well as disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Pact of Negation to protect the combo. The goal is to execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible to secure the win.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent while disrupting their plans with counterspells. By drawing cards quickly with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder, the deck can set up explosive plays with cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent. With a strong mana base and removal options like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this BUG Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage through counterspells, removal, and card draw. The deck focuses on controlling the board through cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Force of Will, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent for pressure. The deck also includes cards like Ponder and Brainstorm for deck manipulation, as well as Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for additional card advantage. Wasteland is included for land disruption, and the mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells across three different colors.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly deploy aggressive threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent in order to quickly overwhelm your opponent. By utilizing disruption spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Stifle, as well as efficient removal like Lightning Bolt and Brazen Borrower, you can maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. Price of Progress can also punish opponents for playing nonbasic lands, while the deck's mana base allows for consistent tempo plays and allows for flexibility in card selection.
